profile.subtitleJa: ガリラヤ出身で、人口調査の時期に反乱を起こした人物。

profile.identityNoteJa: この項目は5:37が述べるガリラヤ出身のユダを指す。同名の人物を一括して扱わない。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: WEB本文で名前を直接確認。本文: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

review.identityCheckJa: 使徒言行録の各出現箇所を読んで同名人物、表記の違い、索引の誤リンクを照合。個人史が本文にない場合は推測を加えない。
review.spoilerCheckJa: 導入文を最初の出現箇所で分かる範囲に限定。後の行為を導入へ混入していない。
